description: This file implements the DobbyEventListener class and its nested OCIContainerNotification class, handling container lifecycle events and notifying a runtime manager.

classes.name: DobbyEventListener
classes.description: Handles container events and communicates with runtime manager.

classes.name: DobbyEventListener::OCIContainerNotification
classes.description: Receives container lifecycle notifications and triggers events.

methods.name: DobbyEventListener::DobbyEventListener
methods.description: Constructor, initializes notification and event handler.

methods.name: DobbyEventListener::initialize
methods.description: Registers notification with OCI container object.

methods.name: DobbyEventListener::deinitialize
methods.description: Unregisters notification from OCI container object.

methods.name: DobbyEventListener::OCIContainerNotification::OnContainerStarted
methods.description: Handles container start event, sends notification.

methods.name: DobbyEventListener::OCIContainerNotification::OnContainerStopped
methods.description: Handles container stop event, sends notification.

methods.name: DobbyEventListener::OCIContainerNotification::OnContainerFailed
methods.description: Handles container failure event, sends notification.

methods.name: DobbyEventListener::OCIContainerNotification::OnContainerStateChanged
methods.description: Handles container state change, maps to runtime states, sends notification.
